sourceEvidence.role: Accepted input cost1; ineffective blocked0; automatic chains no extra cost; own-player accepted actions instead of elapsed time.
Fixed bomb first push3,next own actions2,1,explode; actual displacement required.
Open decisions: automatic-chain priority, spike lowering, bomb range/damage remain unresolved.
Original environment scope, no devices,one sun/nonrepeat horizon/repeating sea. Old pixel rules superseded.
Current user angular/native art, common/coast behavior, logical/water/occupancy/export contract.

fixed: Player actually steps on cell:flat->occupied armed with small tips.
Only actual departure from armed cell raises spikes and blocks return.
Invalid/blocked attempted departure does not raise.
unresolved: Lowering/reset condition; do not invent a timer or N-turn cycle.
art: One-cell base fixed; hidden,occupied warning,rise native phases,raised locked state distinguishable.
rules.hostDelegation: Host saved state/reset/undo is authoritative. Do not infer extra triggers for crates/other actors.

fixed: After actual boarding, same existing actor and boat move together exactly1 water cell per accepted swipe.
Blocked water target: neither moves.
Disembark only valid land; actor goes to land and boat stays in last water cell.
Blocked land: invalid; actor remains boarded.
unresolved: Any existing host-specific boarding, reservation, actor identity and collision policy must be resolved in actual project.
art: E/N/W/S independent native headings, bow/oar/wake direction agree.
Visual slot1x1 unless actual host evidence differs; no invented player sprite.
rules.hostDelegation: Same actor visual follows single authoritative path/tween; no duplicate logical move, clone actor or second action cost.

fixed: One valid push rolls in same direction to cell immediately before obstacle.
Pusher destination is original barrel cell only, never final barrel destination or full rolling path.
First target blocked:whole push invalid/no displacement/cost/turn.
Each intermediate cell shown along host committed route.
unresolved: Cross-device/terrain priority remains actual host behavior; do not invent water/floating/extra force rules.
art: Bold6-8-sided faceted barrel, angular hoops/grain; E/N/W/S native roll phases and settle.
Stop prediction uses supplied host route only.
rules.hostDelegation: Host owns committed route and obstacle stop; animation callbacks never move logical cells.

fixed: Successful FIRST actual-displacing push ignites and displays3.
First push does not immediately change3->2.
Subsequent own-player accepted actions:2,1,then explosion after the third subsequent action.
Invalid input/no actual bomb displacement cannot ignite; ineffective input cannot tick.
Automatic substeps do not add own actions/ticks.
Existing cracked walls in supplied authoritative blast cells break.
unresolved: Damage to player/ordinary objects and any chain reaction rules are not specified.
art: Large native generated3/2/1 glyphs, inert/ignite/countdown/detonate/spent feedback.
Visual blast outline/FX only on explicit supplied host cells.
rules.hostDelegation: No defaultcross/radius/damage or newwall two-hit health. Unique own committed action and existing saved state are authoritative, never elapsed animation/fuse time.

fixed: Enter->same printed direction until end or before obstruction, no additional chain cost.
art: Body axis,arrows and native scroll all equal actual E/N/W/S travel.

fixed: Exactly1 occupied cell; output is check-only.
Opposite/both side approaches closed bar+redX,0move/cost/turn.
Blocked output does not open even in allowed heading.
art: 164px minimum clear passage; fixed rails and open transparent center.

fixed: Existing45degree face redirects forced travel90degrees without new input cost.
Blocked outgoing path stops before inaccessible corner; use actual host map.
art: Thin open L,NE/NW/SE/SW,square fasteners; no oversized blocked-looking tips.

fixed: Accepted forced travel stops on this same cell, no rebound/carry/extra cost.
art: Stopbars perpendicular to actual incoming axis; no transport arrow.
